name: Dak Bungalow Hotel & Restaurant
why_it_matters: Walking distance from the Mughal Garden — one of the few sit-down options in Verinag that travellers consistently rate highly. Family-run; the kitchen sticks to home-style Kashmiri preparations rather than tourist-menu compromises.
insider_tip: Lunch service is the safer bet — kitchens in this part of South Kashmir wind down early and dinner can be slow if you arrive after a tour-bus rush. Ask if trout is on; supply is intermittent.
signature_address: Near Mughal Garden, Verinag, Anantnag District 192212

name: Jahangir Hotel & Restaurant
why_it_matters: One of the older roadside hotel-restaurants on the Verinag stretch — basic but reliable rajma-chawal and Kashmiri staples for a quick break before continuing south to Sinthan or back to Srinagar. JustDial average sits at 3.6/5, which in this part of the valley reads as 'honest workhorse'.
insider_tip: Order what's already cooking on the fire — the open kitchen at the entrance shows the morning's pot of rogan josh; it lands faster and tastes sharper than anything cooked-to-order.

name: JKTDC Tourist Bungalow Verinag
why_it_matters: The state tourism corporation's huts at Verinag run an in-house cook rather than a public-facing restaurant — meals are prepared on order for staying guests but the kitchen will usually serve walk-in day-trippers who pre-call. Inventory is whatever the cook bought that morning at Verinag chowk.
insider_tip: Phone the JKTDC Srinagar office (0194-2502274) the morning of your visit and ask the manager to pre-arrange lunch — the kitchen is cold otherwise and you'll wait 90 minutes for a fire.
signature_address: JKTDC Tourist Huts, Verinag, Anantnag District 192212
